newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes end steady, grade values mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes end steady, grade values mostly weaker.

text.p: Spot U.S. crude prices ended steady Wednesday finding pressure from a lackluster NYMEX futures close, but support in the aftermarket.

Domestic grade differentials mostly eased, notably in the Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire where values declined around 20 cents to only a 50 cents premium to the January West Texas Intermediate/Cushing benchmark.
Jan WTI/Cushing settled down around 15 cents at $24.75-85 a barrel against the NYMEX close, but U.S. aftermarket window buying brought the same marker up to the $24.95-$25.05 level.
A Wall Street trader bought parcels at those ranges.
